items.title: Single-shot and agentic retrieval with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports single-shot RAG and retrieval-only requests through AgenticRetrieveStream, alongside agentic retrieval. This post explains how the maxAgentIteration parameter matches retrieval effort to each request, using an illustrative internal banking policy assistant.
items.creator: Siddhant Sahu

items.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 on AWS
items.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 are now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. Learn what's new in both models, why Fable 5.2 matters for your technical workloads, and how to get started building with it on Amazon Bedrock.
items.creator: Dani Mitchell
